ApplyScheduledPlan.description_en: This operation applies a scheduled plan

ChatAiAgent.description_en: Initiates a streaming conversation with an AI Agent

CreateDeploymentDraft.description_en: Creates a draft for an SQL or data ingestion job
CreateDeploymentDraft.description_zh: 创建SQL、数据摄入作业的草稿

CreateMember.description_en: Adds a user to a namespace as a member and grants permissions to the user
CreateMember.description_zh: 将一个用户添加到对应项目空间下并授予对应权限

CreateSqlFile.description_en: Creates a SQL query script job file
CreateSqlFile.description_zh: 该接口用于创建一个 SQL 类型的查询脚本作业文件

CreateUdfArtifact.description_en: Parses all user-defined function (UDF) methods in your JAR or Python file and creates an artifact configuration for a UDF
CreateUdfArtifact.description_zh: 通过对您上传的Jar/Python包的解析，解析您Jar/Python包中全部的UDF方法并为你创建自定义函数文件

DeleteCustomConnector.description_en: Deletes a registered custom connector from a workspace
DeleteCustomConnector.description_zh: 删除已经注册的自定义连接器

DeleteDeployment.description_en: Deletes a deployment based on the deployment ID
DeleteDeployment.description_zh: 根据已部署作业ID删除已部署作业

DeleteDeploymentByName.description_en: Deletes the deployment instance information of a job in a specified workspace and namespace based on the deployed job name
DeleteDeploymentByName.description_zh: 本接口用于根据已部署作业名称删除指定工作空间和项目空间下的作业部署实例信息

DeleteDeploymentDraft.description_en: Deletes a draft of an SQL or data ingestion job. The draft cannot be deleted if it has any published or running deployment
DeleteDeploymentDraft.description_zh: 删除SQL、数据摄入作业草稿，如该草稿存在已经上线或运行中的部署作业，则无法删除

DeleteFolder.description_en: Deletes an empty folder. If files or folders exist in a folder, the folder cannot be deleted
DeleteFolder.description_zh: 删除空文件夹，如果该文件夹下存在其他文件或文件夹则无法删除

DeleteJob.description_en: Deletes the information about a job that is not in the running state in a deployment
DeleteJob.description_zh: 删除一个作业下非运行状态的作业实例信息

DeleteMember.description_en: Revokes the permissions from a member
DeleteMember.description_zh: 删除指定的用户权限信息

DeleteSqlFile.description_en: Deletes a created SQL query script file
DeleteSqlFile.description_zh: 该接口用于删除一个已创建的 SQL 查询脚本文件

DeleteUdfArtifact.description_en: Deletes a user-defined function (UDF) resource. You must delete all UDFs registered with the resource before you can delete the resource
DeleteUdfArtifact.description_zh: 删除已经创建的自定义函数资源，删除前需要您先删除该资源下注册的自定义函数

DeleteUdfFunction.description_en: Deletes an existing user-defined function (UDF) from a Realtime Compute for Apache Flink workspace
DeleteUdfFunction.description_zh: 删除已注册的自定义函数

DeployDeploymentDraftAsync.description_en: Deploys a draft of an SQL job

ExecuteSqlStatement.description_en: Runs metadata-related SQL statements. Only DDL and DML statements are supported. DQL statements are not supported
ExecuteSqlStatement.description_zh: 您可以通过本API完成元数据相关SQL的运行，仅支持DDL和DML，不支持DQL

FetchSqlExecutionResult.description_en: Retrieves the execution result of an SQL data query submitted through the platform
FetchSqlExecutionResult.description_zh: 该接口用于获取平台提交的 SQL 数据查询执行结果

FlinkApiProxy.description_en: Provides a proxy for Realtime Compute for Apache Flink requests
FlinkApiProxy.description_zh: 您可以使用flink rest api的方式来调用本接口，获取session集群或者运行作业的相关信息。注意本接口仅支持您获取相关信息，无法对session集群和作业进行操作或管理

GenerateResourcePlanWithFlinkConfAsync.description_en: Submits a ticket that applies for asynchronous generation of the fine-grained resources. This operation returns the ID of the ticket for you to query the asynchronous generation result
GenerateResourcePlanWithFlinkConfAsync.description_zh: 提交异步生成resource plan工单，返回一个异步工单ID用于查询工单结果

GetAppliedScheduledPlan.description_en: Retrieves the execution plan for an application

GetCatalogs.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified catalog or all catalogs

GetDatabases.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified database or lists all databases under a specified catalog
GetDatabases.description_zh: 获取指定Catalog下DataBase的信息或列出所有DataBase的信息

GetDeployDeploymentDraftResult.description_en: Checks the deployment result of a job draft
GetDeployDeploymentDraftResult.description_zh: 根据作业草稿部署异步工单的ID信息，查看部署的结果

GetDeployment.description_en: Obtains the details of a deployment
GetDeployment.description_zh: 获取已部署作业的详细信息

GetDeploymentDraft.description_en: Retrieves the details of an SQL or data ingestion job draft
GetDeploymentDraft.description_zh: 获取SQL、数据摄入作业草稿详情

GetDeploymentDraftLock.description_en: Before using an API to edit, validate, or deploy a job draft, you must acquire an edit lock to prevent conflicts between user interface (UI) and API operations. Acquiring this lock requires either the "Develop SQL/YAML Job (Create, Edit)" or "Unlock SQL/YAML Job Draft" permission
GetDeploymentDraftLock.description_zh: 当您调用API编辑、检查、部署作业草稿时，为避免页面操作和API操作互相影响，您需要先获取作业草稿锁。拥有【开发SQL/YAML作业（创建、编辑）】或【解锁SQL/YAML作业草稿】任一权限即可获取锁

GetDeploymentsByIp.description_en: Gets a list of deployed jobs and their information on a node by a specified IP address
GetDeploymentsByIp.description_zh: 本接口支持通过指定IP查询该节点上已部署作业列表以及作业信息

GetDeploymentsByLabel.description_en: Queries a list of deployed jobs and their information by a specified label
GetDeploymentsByLabel.description_zh: 本接口支持通过指定标签查询关联的已部署作业列表以及作业信息

GetDeploymentsByName.description_en: Retrieves deployed job instances by name from a specified workspace and namespace
GetDeploymentsByName.description_zh: 本接口用于通过已部署作业名称搜索并获取指定工作空间和项目空间下匹配的已部署作业实例

GetFolder.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific folder
GetFolder.description_zh: 获取文件夹的具体信息

GetGenerateResourcePlanResult.description_en: Obtains the asynchronous generation result of fine-grained resources based on the ID of the ticket that applies for an asynchronous generation
GetGenerateResourcePlanResult.description_zh: 根据异步工单ID获取异步生成细粒度资源结果

GetHotUpdateJobResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of a hot update for a job
GetHotUpdateJobResult.description_zh: 对作业进行动态更新时，可通过本API获取作业动态更新的结果

GetJob.description_en: Retrieves detailed information about a job instance
GetJob.description_zh: 获取作业实例的详细信息

GetJobDiagnosis.description_en: Performs intelligent diagnostics on a job and retrieves information about abnormal diagnostic items
GetJobDiagnosis.description_zh: 智能诊断作业，获取异常诊断项信息

GetLatestJobStartLog.description_en: Obtains the latest startup logs of a job
GetLatestJobStartLog.description_zh: 获取作业实例最新的启动日志

GetLineageInfo.description_en: Obtains the lineage information of a deployment
GetLineageInfo.description_zh: 通过本API可以获取作业和数据的血缘信息

GetMember.description_en: Queries the permissions of a member

GetPatrolReportDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of an inspection report

GetSavepoint.description_en: Queries details of a savepoint and checkpoint
GetSavepoint.description_zh: 获取快照和系统检查点的详细信息

GetSqlFile.description_en: Retrieves the details of a created SQL query script
GetSqlFile.description_zh: 该接口用于获取已创建的 SQL 查询脚本详情

GetTables.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific table or information about all tables under a specified database in a catalog
GetTables.description_zh: 获取指定catalog的database下某张表的具体详情或者database下所有表的信息

GetUdfArtifacts.description_en: Obtains the details of the JAR or Python file that corresponds to the user-defined function (UDF) that you upload and create
GetUdfArtifacts.description_zh: 获取您上传并创建的包含UDF的Jar或者Python文件的详情信息

GetValidateDeploymentDraftResult.description_en: Queries the depth validation result of a job draft by ticket ID
GetValidateDeploymentDraftResult.description_zh: 根据ticketId查询作业草稿深度校验的结果

HotUpdateJob.description_en: Dynamically updates parameters or resources of a deployment that is running
HotUpdateJob.description_zh: 对正在运行的作业进行参数或资源的动态更新

ListAutopilotTuningHistories.description_en: Retrieves the Autopilot tuning history records

ListCustomConnectors.description_en: Obtains a list of existing custom connectors
ListCustomConnectors.description_zh: 获取已注册的自定义连接器的列表信息

ListDeploymentDrafts.description_en: Retrieves a list of SQL or data ingestion job drafts
ListDeploymentDrafts.description_zh: 获取SQL、数据摄入作业草稿的列表信息

ListDeploymentTargets.description_en: Obtains a list of clusters in which deployments can be deployed. The cluster can be a session cluster or a per-job cluster
ListDeploymentTargets.description_zh: 获取作业可部署目标的列表，部署目标是session集群或者perjob集群

ListDeployments.description_en: Retrieve information about all deployed jobs
ListDeployments.description_zh: 获取所有已部署作业的信息

ListEngineVersionMetadata.description_en: Obtains a list of engine versions that are supported by Realtime Compute for Apache Flink
ListEngineVersionMetadata.description_zh: 获取系统支持的引擎版本列表

ListJobs.description_en: Retrieves information about all job instances for a specified deployment
ListJobs.description_zh: 获取到某个已部署作业下所有作业实例的信息

ListMembers.description_en: Queries the mappings between the ID and permissions of a member in a specific namespace
ListMembers.description_zh: 查看特定项目下用户UID和授权的对应关系

ListPatrolReports.description_en: Queries the list of inspection reports

ListSavepoints.description_en: Obtains a list of savepoints or checkpoints
ListSavepoints.description_zh: 获取作业快照及最近系统检查点列表

ListScheduledPlan.description_zh: 获取定时计划的列表信息

ListScheduledPlanExecutedHistory.description_en: Retrieves the execution history of a scheduled plan
ListScheduledPlanExecutedHistory.description_zh: 获取定时计划执行历史

RegisterCustomConnector.description_en: Registers a custom connector in a namespace. The registered custom connector can be used in SQL statements
RegisterCustomConnector.description_zh: 在项目空间下注册自定义连接器，注册的自定义连接器可以在SQL中使用

RegisterUdfFunction.description_en: Registers specific or all of the user-defined functions (UDFs) that are parsed from the JAR files. The registered functions can be used in SQL statements
RegisterUdfFunction.description_zh: 通过本API可以选择已创建的自定义函数文件中解析出的自定义函数，选择其中的部分或全部函数进行注册，注册后可在SQL中使用

StartJob.description_en: Create and start a job instance
StartJob.description_zh: 创建并启动一个作业实例

StartSqlExecution.description_en: Executes an SQL data query script task
StartSqlExecution.description_zh: 该接口用于执行sql数据查询脚本任务

StopApplyScheduledPlan.description_en: Stops the application of a scheduled plan

StopSqlExecution.description_en: Executes an SQL query script task
StopSqlExecution.description_zh: 该接口用于执行sql数据查询脚本任务

UpdateDeployment.description_zh: 更新已部署作业的信息

UpdateDeploymentByName.description_en: Updates the details and configuration parameters of a deployment job by its name
UpdateDeploymentByName.description_zh: 该接口支持根据部署作业名称更新部署作业详情以及配置参数等

UpdateDeploymentDraft.description_en: Updates the draft of an SQL or data ingestion job
UpdateDeploymentDraft.description_zh: 更新SQL、数据摄入作业草稿

UpdateFolder.description_zh: 调用本API可完成对文件夹信息的更新

UpdateMember.description_en: Updates the permissions of one or more members in a specific namespace
UpdateMember.description_zh: 更新特定项目空间下某个或某些用户的权限

UpdateSqlFile.description_en: Updates a created SQL query script
UpdateSqlFile.description_zh: 该接口用于跟更新已创建的 SQL 查询脚本

UpdateUdfArtifact.description_en: Updates the JAR file of the user-defined function (UDF) that you create
UpdateUdfArtifact.description_zh: 对已创建的自定义函数文件进行更新

UpdateVariable.description_en: Updates the information about a variable in a namespace

ValidateDeploymentDraftAsync.description_en: Asynchronously performs an in-depth check of a Flink job draft to validate its syntax and resource configuration
ValidateDeploymentDraftAsync.description_zh: 异步进行Flink作业草稿深度检查，进行语法检查、资源配置等合法性检验

ValidateSqlStatement.description_en: Verifies the code of an SQL deployment
